description: This file contains classes and functions for migrating various visualization configurations in the Superset project, including treemaps, pivot tables, sunburst charts, timeseries, and other chart types. It defines migration classes that modify visualization data structures and build queries accordingly.

classes.name: MigrateTreeMap
classes.description: Class for migrating treemap visualizations to a new format.

classes.name: MigratePivotTable
classes.description: Class for migrating pivot table visualizations to a new format.

classes.name: MigrateDualLine
classes.description: Class for migrating dual line charts to a mixed timeseries format.

classes.name: TimeseriesChart
classes.description: Base class for migrating timeseries and related chart types.

classes.name: MigrateLineChart
classes.description: Class for migrating line charts, extending TimeseriesChart.

classes.name: MigrateAreaChart
classes.description: Class for migrating area charts, extending TimeseriesChart.

classes.name: MigrateBarChart
classes.description: Class for migrating bar charts, extending TimeseriesChart.

classes.name: MigrateDistBarChart
classes.description: Class for migrating distribution bar charts, extending TimeseriesChart.

classes.name: MigrateBubbleChart
classes.description: Class for migrating bubble charts, extending MigrateViz.

classes.name: MigrateHeatmapChart
classes.description: Class for migrating heatmap charts, extending MigrateViz.

classes.name: MigrateHistogramChart
classes.description: Class for migrating histogram charts, extending MigrateViz.

classes.name: MigrateSankey
classes.description: Class for migrating sankey diagrams, extending MigrateViz.

methods.name: _pre_action
methods.description: Method to prepare or modify data before query building, specific to each visualization type.

methods.name: _build_query
methods.description: Method to construct the query object for the visualization, customized per class.

methods.name: _migrate_temporal_filter
methods.description: Method to handle migration of temporal filters in dual line charts.

methods.name: process_fn
methods.description: Inner function used in query building to process form data into query objects.
